newsitem.title: GERMANY: Braun reports record profits for 1995/96.
newsitem.headline: Braun reports record profits for 1995/96.

text.p: Braun AG, German subsidiary of U.S. razor blade giant Gillette Co., said Friday its 1995/96 operating profit rose 18 percent to a record $300 million.
Revenue, which the electrical goods manufacturer reports in its domestic currency, rose 11 percent to 2.62 billion German marks ($1.5 billion).

Braun Management Board Chairman Archie Livis said that despite the continued weak consumer climate across most of Europe he expected an overall positive development in its business during the current year.
Braun said it expects a significant increase in sales volumes of electrical irons and hairstyling products.
